item.title: How the surging cost of going out is changing American life
item.description: With the cost of concerts, sports games and restaurants far outpacing inflation, more people are staying home.

item.description: At the University of Texas, Republican Bo French drew widespread, bipartisan condemnation for his attack on South Asian students celebrating their football team’s win.

item.description: Some lawmakers and industry leaders have called for moving more slowly on the technology.

item.description: The president has been hearing blunt news from advisers about the GOP’s chances in the midterm elections and has signaled he understands that he has contributed to the poor political environment.

item.description: Family lore said she wrote an article about her concentration camp experience soon after liberation, Daniella Greenbaum Davis writes.

item.title: CNN, MS NOW say journalists blocked from White House after Trump announces ban on three outlets
item.description: President Donald Trump said Friday he would block MS NOW, CNN and Politico from White House grounds. News outlets and press advocacy groups condemned the move and said it was a violation of the First Amendment.

item.title: Secret contracts reveal undisclosed terms in Trump’s drug-pricing deals
item.description: The Trump administration’s confidential deals with pharmaceutical companies to lower U.S. drug prices include inducements to raise drug prices overseas and promise protection from President Donald Trump’s tariffs, according to documents shared with The Washington Post.

item.title: Hundreds of Kennedy Center supporters rally outside the shuttered arts institution, chanting ‘Hands off!’
item.description: The vigil, which had been in the works for months, took on fresh urgency at the end of a week that saw the doors to the marble building locked shut, while President Donald Trump indicated the structure could be “ripped down” if his name isn’t added to the institution.

item.title: Fight intensifies in California over the fate of homes falling into the sea
item.description: Homeowners are building a costly rock wall to hold back the ocean, escalating a battle over private property and what to do about years-long beach erosion amid storm damage and higher tides.

item.title: Trump says U.S. will defend Greenland as part of ‘permanent’ security deal with Denmark
item.description: The agreement, which Danish officials said is not final, stops far short of Trump's often-stated goal of taking possession of the territory.

item.title: Fresh layoffs begin at Kennedy Center as closure continues
item.description: The cuts come as the center’s main building remains closed during a widening legal battle over President Donald Trump’s transformation of the national cultural institution.

item.title: The nativist provocateur who keeps pushing the Texas GOP further right
item.description: Republican leaders criticized a recent post by Bo French attacking South Asian UT students. But many in the party have felt compelled to embrace parts of his ideology.

item.title: Trump says he’s banning CNN, MS NOW and Politico from the White House for reporting ‘fake news’
item.description: The president has consistently feuded with news organizations and at times tried to ban them and their journalists from the White House.

item.title: More U.S. troops have died amid Iran war than Pentagon has disclosed publicly
item.description: Officials who spoke with The Post expressed frustration that the additional loss of life in the Middle East is not reflected in the Defense Department’s casualty database.

item.description: Officials are bracing for the pending release of an investigation into Yamada’s conduct that includes how a trip to Las Vegas was funded.

item.description: In a matter of weeks, Russia has been linked to a series of provocative attacks and plots that — had any one of them turned deadly — carried the potential to trigger a dangerous escalation in the war in Ukraine and the West’s broader conflict with Moscow, according to security officials and experts.

item.title: Why probiotics don’t usually help your gut — and what to do instead
item.description: Probiotics use has climbed in recent years. But fiber-rich plants, not supplements, are the best fuel for your gut microbiome, writes columnist Anahad O’Connor.

item.title: Trump withdraws his nominee to lead ICE amid mounting signs Lance Schroyer would face resistance in Senate
item.description: The Senate has not confirmed an ICE director in over a decade. Trump selected Schroyer, a former Oklahoma Highway Patrol major and Marine, for the role less than three months ago.

item.title: Photo of Trump with printout appearing to refer to potential Kennedy Center demolition is cited as evidence in new court filing
item.description: The image surfaced hours after the president warned that the performing arts venue could eventually be “ripped down” without his intervention. Lawyers for Rep. Joyce Beatty (D-Ohio), a Kennedy Center trustee challenging Trump’s transformation of the institution, filed a copy in federal court Thursday.

item.title: Former youth minister Jeff Taylor is indicted on sex abuse charges after FBI probe
item.description: Taylor worked at one of the most prominent churches in Northern Virginia, Falls Church Episcopal, in the 1990s and early 2000s. He has been arrested and charged with coercing and trying to coerce three minors into sexual activity, according to a federal grand jury indictment.

item.title: Afghan man convicted of terrorism is sentenced to 20 years in prison for role in 2021 Kabul airport bombing
item.description: Mohammad Sharifullah was the only person convicted in connection with the attack at Kabul airport’s Abbey Gate during the U.S. withdrawal from Afghanistan. The jury convicted Sharifullah of helping ISIS leaders that day but did not find that the prosecution had sufficiently proved that the man’s role in the attack directly resulted in the deaths of 13 U.S. service members.

item.title: Trump’s arch will harm dozens of historic sites but must proceed, federal officials say
item.description: National Park Service officials acknowledge that, if built as planned, President Donald Trump’s triumphal arch would adversely affect Arlington National Cemetery, the Lincoln Memorial and several dozen other historic sites, but they say the project must move forward, according to an NPS document and emails obtained by The Washington Post.

item.title: Lawmaker requests emergency hearing on Kennedy Center closure, escalating fight over Trump’s transformation of the venue
item.description: The challenge from Rep. Joyce Beatty (D-Ohio), a Kennedy Center trustee who has repeatedly challenged the president in court, puts the question of the Kennedy Center’s physical future back before U.S. District Judge Christopher Cooper barely 24 hours after he blocked another attempt to put President Donald Trump’s name on the building.
